Intel：电脑组装与部件指南: Intel: PC building and component guide
让所有硬件协同工作的连接平台。: The connection platform that lets hardware work together.
CPU 插槽、内存插槽和扩展接口通过主板上的线路连接。部分高速通道由 CPU 直: Traces on the motherboard link the CPU socket, memory slots, and expansion interfaces. Some high-speed lanes connect directly to the CPU; other devices connect through the chipset.
固定处理器并建立电气连接。: Holds the processor and makes its electrical connections.
这里以 LGA 插槽作示意：弹性触点位于主板插槽内，CPU 底部是接触焊盘。不同: This model shows an LGA socket: spring contacts are in the motherboard socket and contact pads are on the CPU underside. Sockets from different platforms are not interchangeable.
执行指令，协调程序的计算与控制。: Executes instructions and coordinates computation and control.
启动程序时，操作系统把程序所需内容调入内存，CPU 通过缓存层级读取指令和数据，: When a program starts, the operating system loads the required content into memory. The CPU reads instructions and data through its cache hierarchy, then performs computations. It does not execute instructions directly from a drive one by one.
把处理器的热量传递给空气。: Transfers heat from the processor to the air.
热量经过导热界面材料、底座和热管传到鳍片，风扇推动空气穿过鳍片。散热器必须与 C: Heat travels through thermal interface material, the base, and heat pipes to the fins. A fan moves air through those fins. The heatsink must make reliable thermal contact with the CPU.
推动空气穿过散热鳍片。: Moves air through the heatsink fins.
主板根据温度与风扇曲线调节转速。风扇转动不等于散热正常，底座接触不良同样会造成温: The motherboard adjusts fan speed using temperatures and a fan curve. A spinning fan does not guarantee effective cooling: poor contact at the heatsink base can still cause overheating.
暂存正在使用的程序与数据。: Temporarily holds programs and data currently in use.
内存读写速度快，但断电后通常不保留数据。CPU 访问工作数据时会经过缓存层级；内: RAM provides fast reads and writes but usually loses its contents when power is removed. The CPU accesses working data through its cache hierarchy. RAM and SSD storage serve different roles.
与另一条内存共同提供工作空间。: Works with the other memory module to provide working space.
成对安装在主板手册指定的插槽，通常可以启用双通道。可用容量、频率与兼容性由 CP: Installing a pair in the slots specified by the motherboard manual usually enables dual-channel operation. Capacity, speed, and compatibility depend on the CPU, motherboard, and memory together.
并行处理图形与其他适合并行的任务。: Processes graphics and other tasks suited to parallel computation.
游戏中，CPU 准备场景与绘制命令，GPU 完成大量并行计算并生成帧。显示信号经: In games, the CPU prepares the scene and draw commands. The GPU performs extensive parallel computation and produces frames. Its output ports send display signals to the monitor.
为显卡散热鳍片提供气流。: Provides airflow for the graphics card's heatsink fins.
显卡把电能的一部分转化为热量。温控系统按负载与温度调整风扇，部分显卡在低负载时会: A graphics card converts some electrical energy into heat. Its thermal controls adjust fan speed according to load and temperature; some cards stop their fans at low loads.
与另一只风扇共同覆盖显卡散热器。: Works with the other fan to cover the GPU heatsink.
两只风扇共同推动空气经过鳍片。真实显卡的风向和风扇数量因型号而异，此模型使用双风: Both fans move air through the fins. Airflow direction and fan count vary between real graphics cards; this model uses a two-fan example.
连接显卡等高速扩展设备。: Connects high-speed expansion devices such as graphics cards.
PCIe 用多条串行通道传输数据。外形长度、实际通道数和协议代际共同影响扩展设备: PCIe transfers data over serial lanes. Physical slot length, actual lane count, and protocol generation together determine the connection capabilities available to a device.
长期保存操作系统、程序和文件。: Stores the operating system, programs, and files long term.
此处使用 NVMe SSD 示意，通过 PCIe 传输数据。程序运行所需内容会调: This example is an NVMe SSD using PCIe to transfer data. Content needed by a running program is loaded into memory. M.2 specifies a form factor and interface; not every M.2 device uses NVMe.
通过磁性盘片保存大容量数据。: Stores large amounts of data on magnetic platters.
机械硬盘依靠旋转盘片和磁头读写。它需要数据线和电源连接，适合对随机访问速度要求较: A hard drive reads and writes using rotating platters and magnetic heads. It needs both a data connection and power, and suits bulk storage where fast random access is less critical.
把交流电转换为硬件需要的直流电。: Converts AC input into the DC power required by hardware.
台式电源提供多路直流输出，并通过主板与设备电源线供电。机箱按钮通常向主板发送启动: A desktop PSU provides several DC outputs through motherboard and device power cables. The case button usually signals the motherboard, which controls PSU startup.
为主板提供主要电源连接。: Provides the main power connection to the motherboard.
24 针 ATX 接头包含电源、地线和控制信号。它与 CPU 辅助供电用途不同；: The 24-pin ATX connector carries power, ground, and control signals. It serves a different purpose from auxiliary CPU power. During assembly, ensure its latch is fully engaged.
把电源送到 CPU 周围的供电电路。: Supplies the power circuitry around the CPU.
CPU 辅助供电经过主板 VRM 转换后，为处理器提供合适的低电压。不要与显卡供: The motherboard VRM converts auxiliary CPU power to the low voltage needed by the processor. Do not interchange this connector with a graphics-card power connector.
把输入电压调节为 CPU 所需电压。: Regulates input power to the voltage required by the CPU.
VRM 由控制器、功率器件、电感与电容等组成。它在 CPU 负载快速变化时维持稳: A VRM includes a controller, power devices, inductors, and capacitors. It maintains a stable supply as CPU load changes rapidly, and also generates heat itself.
扩展并管理一部分外围连接。: Provides and manages some peripheral connections.
USB、SATA 等部分 I/O 可由芯片组提供；具体连接方式随平台而异。现代平: The chipset can provide some USB, SATA, and other I/O connections; routing varies by platform. Modern platforms usually integrate the memory controller into the CPU.
在断开主电源时维持实时时钟等低功耗电路。: Keeps the real-time clock and other low-power circuits running when main power is disconnected.
电池耗尽常表现为时间重置或部分固件设置丢失，并不等同于整机完全无法通电。不同主板: A depleted battery often causes the clock to reset or some firmware settings to be lost. This does not necessarily mean the computer cannot receive power. Motherboards differ in how they store settings.
保存开机时首先运行的固件。: Stores the firmware that runs first during startup.
UEFI 固件初始化硬件、执行必要检查，并按照启动配置寻找操作系统引导程序。固件: UEFI firmware initializes hardware, performs required checks, and looks for an operating-system bootloader according to the boot configuration. It resides in nonvolatile flash memory.
为 SATA 硬盘提供数据连接。: Provides data connections for SATA drives.
SATA 数据线连接主板与存储设备；供电由独立电源线提供。仅接数据线不能让硬盘工: A SATA data cable connects the motherboard to a storage device. A separate power cable supplies power. A data cable alone cannot operate a drive.
连接键盘、鼠标与外部设备。: Connects keyboards, mice, and external devices.
USB 可以传输数据并提供一定功率。连接器外形并不能单独说明速度、显示支持或充电: USB can transfer data and supply power. Connector shape alone does not establish speed, display support, or charging capability; check the device specifications.
通过网线接入局域网。: Connects to a local network through an Ethernet cable.
网络控制器把系统中的网络数据与以太网链路连接起来。网页请求还涉及操作系统协议栈、: The network controller links the system's network data to the Ethernet connection. A web request also involves the operating-system network stack, a router, and a remote server.
把显卡生成的画面送往显示器。: Sends images generated by the graphics card to a monitor.
使用独立显卡时，显示器通常连接到显卡上的 HDMI 或 DisplayPort。: With a discrete graphics card, the monitor normally connects to HDMI or DisplayPort on the card. Whether motherboard display outputs work depends on the CPU and system configuration.
把较冷的外部空气送入机箱。: Draws cooler outside air into the case.
合理风道让冷空气经过发热部件，再由后部或顶部排出。实际气流受机箱开孔、滤网、风扇: A useful airflow path carries cool air past heat-generating parts and out through the rear or top. Actual flow depends on case openings, filters, fan direction, and resistance.
把机箱内的热空气排出。: Expels warm air from the case.
排风与进风共同形成气流通路。模型中的热流线表示总体方向，并非流体仿真或实际温度测: Intake and exhaust fans work together to form an airflow path. The model's thermal lines indicate general direction, not fluid simulation or measured temperatures.
向主板发送开机请求。: Sends a startup request to the motherboard.
机箱电源按钮通过前面板接针接入主板。正常关机状态下，按下按钮可请求电源启动；它不: The case power button connects to the motherboard's front-panel header. From a normal shutdown state, pressing it requests PSU startup. It is separate from the AC switch on the rear of the PSU.
固定硬件，同时组织防护和风道。: Supports hardware while providing protection and airflow structure.
此处采用开放框架，方便观察内部关系。真实机箱还包括线缆空间、滤网、安装支架和不同: An open frame makes the internal relationships visible here. Real cases also include cable space, filters, mounting brackets, and mounting holes for supported form factors.
封闭机箱侧面，形成完整外壳。: Closes the side of the case to complete its enclosure.
侧板会影响机箱风道和噪声表现。教学模式默认隐藏侧板，以便观察内部部件；可在目录中: The side panel affects airflow and noise. It is hidden by default in this teaching model so internal parts remain visible. Select it in the catalog or use the side-panel checkbox to show it.
从处理器到内存，建立硬件地图: Build a hardware map, from CPU to memory
处理器位于主板的 CPU 插槽上方、散热器下方。找到并选中中央处理器。: The processor sits in the motherboard's CPU socket, below the heatsink. Find and select the central processing unit.
程序正在使用的指令和数据通常放在内存里。选中「内存 A」，观察它与 CPU 的位: Instructions and data currently in use are generally held in memory. Select Memory A and observe its position relative to the CPU.
断电后，SSD 中的文件仍然保留。选中 M.2 固态硬盘，对比它与内存的职责。: Files on an SSD remain after power is disconnected. Select the M.2 solid-state drive and compare its role with memory.
CPU 工作时会发热。找到 CPU 散热器，沿着关联部件查看热量的去向。: A working CPU generates heat. Find the CPU heatsink, then follow the related components to see where heat goes.
跟随数据从 SSD 到处理器: Follow data from the SSD to the processor
操作系统中的可执行文件保存在存储设备上。先选中 M.2 固态硬盘。: An executable file is stored on a storage device. Select the M.2 solid-state drive first.
把需要的内容调入内存: Load the required content into memory
操作系统把程序需要的代码和数据调入内存；这通常按需发生，并非一次读入整个程序。选: The operating system loads the code and data a program needs into RAM. This usually happens on demand, rather than loading the whole program at once. Select Memory A.
CPU 通过缓存层级获取指令并执行。选中中央处理器，观察它与内存之间的关系。: The CPU obtains instructions through its cache hierarchy and executes them. Select the central processing unit and observe its relationship with memory.
播放「数据流」。蓝色路径依次示意 SSD → 内存 → CPU → GPU →: Play the data flow. Blue paths show SSD → RAM → CPU → GPU → display output in sequence. Real hardware also includes caches, buses, and concurrent activity.
机箱按钮向主板发送启动请求。找到并选中机箱电源按钮。: The case button sends a startup request to the motherboard. Find and select the case power button.
待机电源让启动控制电路保持可用。播放「电力流」，观察电源到主板、CPU 供电模块: Standby power keeps the startup control circuit available. Play the power flow and follow the paths from the PSU to the motherboard, CPU power circuitry, and graphics card.
CPU 开始执行固件代码，初始化必要硬件并进行检查。选中固件存储芯片。: The CPU begins executing firmware, initializing essential hardware and performing checks. Select the firmware flash chip.
交给操作系统: Hand over to the operating system
固件根据启动配置加载引导程序，随后操作系统继续启动。选中存有操作系统的 M.2: Firmware loads a bootloader according to the boot configuration, then the operating system continues startup. Select the M.2 solid-state drive that holds the operating system.
图形程序的概念路径；缓存、控制器与并发传输已简化。: Conceptual graphics-program path; caches, controllers, and concurrent transfers are simplified.
并行供电分支示意；显卡辅助供电是否需要取决于型号。: Parallel supply branches; a GPU's need for auxiliary power depends on its model.
热传导与空气对流的定性示意，不代表温度或流体仿真。: A qualitative view of conduction and convection, not a temperature or fluid simulation.
操作系统按需把 SSD 上的程序内容调入内存。: The operating system loads required program content from the SSD into RAM on demand.
CPU 通过缓存层级取得内存中的指令与数据。: The CPU obtains instructions and data from memory through its cache hierarchy.
CPU 向 GPU 提交绘制命令；图形资源传输在这里简化。: The CPU submits draw commands to the GPU. Graphics-resource transfers are simplified here.
GPU 生成帧，通过显示接口输出。: The GPU produces frames and sends them through the display outputs.
主板、CPU 供电电路与显卡分别获得供电，不是依次串联。: The motherboard, CPU power circuitry, and graphics card receive power through separate branches, not a series chain.
热量从 CPU 经接触底座、热管到达散热鳍片。: Heat travels from the CPU through the contact base and heat pipes to the heatsink fins.
蓝色表示进入的冷空气；珊瑚色表示经过热源后升温、排出的空气。风扇推动空气，不是传: Blue shows cool intake air; coral shows air warmed by the heat source and flowing out. Fans move air, rather than serving as conduction links.
